data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Config consulted by applier (NOT differ); test asserts no import path from differ.py to status config module
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_purity_status.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] AST-walk purity assertion passes on current differ.py (no Name/Attribute/Import references)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_purity_status.py::test_differ_ast_does_not_reference_local_to_jira_status
- [ ] String-literal grep purity assertion passes (catches getattr/dynamic access)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_purity_status.py::test_differ_source_has_no_local_to_jira_status_literal

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_purity_status.py with two complementary checks:

1. AST walk: parse differ.py with ast.parse, walk the tree collecting every ast.Name.id, ast.Attribute.attr, and import-alias name. Assert 'local_to_jira_status' is NOT in the collected set.

2. String literal grep: read differ.py as text, assert the literal substring 'local_to_jira_status' does NOT appear anywhere (catches getattr(config, 'local_to_jira_status') and similar dynamic access patterns the AST walk misses).

The string-literal check is the stronger guard because Python's reflection capabilities make pure AST analysis insufficient. Document this trade-off in the test docstring.

Locate differ.py via __file__ resolution to be worktree-stable: `pathlib.Path(__file__).parents[3] / 'plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py'`.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: AST + string-literal purity test: differ.py does not reference local_to_jira_status
